name: Interface, Inc.
summary: Interface, Inc. designs, produces, and sells modular carpet products in the United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. The company offers modular carpets; luxury vinyl tiles; modular resilient flooring products; rubber flooring; and carpet tiles used in commercial interiors, include offices, educational facilities, healthcare facilities, airports, hospitality spaces, retail spaces, and residential interiors.
